title: a client from another checkout refuses a stale live bus instead of shutting it down
intention: Only the house root (the checkout the house venv's editable cairn install points at) replaces a stale bus at the live home; a client running any other checkout's code raises BusStale there, naming both roots and the CAIRN_BUS_HOME scratch route, and sends no shutdown.
why: Measured 2026-11-12 on akiendelllinux: ~/.cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/0/stops.jsonl holds 8 shutdown verbs between 03:42:39Z and 03:48:29Z, from sail.py chart/cross, a reflection, worktree bin proofs, a tester hollow and test_probescan.py; one replace peaked at 4.9 GB maxrss. Each foreign root's client finds the house bus stale (root differs, server.py ~555-566) and _replace shuts it down; the house root then evicts back. Akien's singleton point, relayed by the orchestrator: one bus per host, so another root takes a scratch bus or refuses loudly, never replaces. Prior art checked: 1029d5146152 (a shutdown drains what it holds) and 99258e9bbdb1 (a draining stale bus is used, not raced) soften a replace but do not stop a foreign root sending one; b38af5fd1852's Q#93 (open-cf43b673ac07) concerns a second copy STARTING, a distinct question.
traces_to: Law 6 (the host's one bus is the house's; a worktree or hollow does not own it and may not end it) and Law 7 (the refusal is loud and names its route, instead of a silent eviction).
how: In cairn/tools/bus_client/remote.py, _replace(home) first checks: when home resolves to _DEFAULT_HOME and _house_root() is not None and Path(_CLASS_ROOT).resolve() != _house_root(), raise BusStale naming both roots and 'CAIRN_BUS_HOME=<scratch home>'. _house_root() reads env CAIRN_BUS_CLIENT_HOUSE_ROOT, else importlib.metadata.distribution('cairn').read_text('direct_url.json'), editable only, with file:// stripped; None when neither resolves (the replace then proceeds as today). Both stale paths (ensure_bus, RemoteBus._call) already go through _replace. The module docstring's decision 4 is narrowed to match. Red-first proof with remote.exchange replaced so nothing dials.

clauses.claim: a client whose class root is not the house root, meeting a stale bus at the live home, sends no op shutdown and raises BusStale whose message names both roots and CAIRN_BUS_HOME
a client whose class root is the house root still sends op shutdown to a stale bus at the live home
a foreign-root client at a scratch home (not the live home) still replaces its stale bus
with no house root resolvable, a foreign-root client at the live home replaces as today

decisions.text: D1: _replace refuses a foreign root at the live home; _house_root() reads the env override, else the editable install's direct_url.json; the docstring's decision 4 is narrowed.
D2: the proof, one tooth per clause, with remote.exchange replaced and _CLASS_ROOT / the house-root env set per tooth.
